name: search_companies
description: Find equity company candidates by symbol or company name. Does not select a company automatically.
enabled: browser mode only; fixture and disabled modes expose search_companies, get_key_statistics and list_metrics
transport: in-page fetch from the signed-in Stockbit tab (ADR 006); allowlisted in sohib/stockbit/api_routes.py
authentication: provider_managed_session; bearer read inside the page, never exported
query_encoding: URL-encode keyword; repeat catalog_types query key for each value.
evidence_distribution: Verification summary only; captured provider responses are not distributed.
